title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigating UPI & Digital Payment Cyber Frauds
source: Synthesized from I4C NCRP-CFCFRMS SOP and RBI Master Directions on Digital Payments Security

steps.title: NCRP Ticket Verification & Emergency Fund Freezing
steps.description: Verify the complaint details on the National Cybercrime Reporting Portal (NCRP) / CFCFRMS dashboard. Ensure that the 12-digit Retrieval Reference Number (RRN), transaction timestamp, and Virtual Payment Address (VPA) are accurately logged to initiate an immediate debit freeze on the beneficiary account or merchant wallet.
required_evidence: Complainant's bank account statement showing debit
NCRP / CFCFRMS Ticket Acknowledgement Number
12-digit RRN / Transaction ID and UPI VPA screenshot
steps.condition_to_start: Receipt of cyber fraud complaint via Helpline 1930 or online portal within the golden hour / investigation window.
steps.condition_to_complete: NPCI and beneficiary banks acknowledge the ticket and confirm the status of funds (frozen, partially frozen, or withdrawn).
if_blocked: Issue a direct emergency Section 106 BNSS notice via official email to the Nodal Officer of the beneficiary bank if the automated NCRP API integration fails.

steps.title: Beneficiary Bank Account KYC & Statement Requisition
steps.description: Issue formal notices to the beneficiary bank(s) identified in the UPI routing logs to obtain comprehensive KYC details, account opening forms, linked mobile numbers, IP login logs, and certified bank statements of the suspect account(s).
required_evidence: Certified bank ledger statement of the suspect account
Account KYC documents (Aadhaar, PAN, photograph, physical address)
Net/Mobile banking login IP addresses and device identifiers
steps.condition_to_start: Beneficiary bank account number and IFSC identified from NPCI/NCRP routing logs.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of certified bank statements, full KYC dossier, and login IP logs from the bank.
if_blocked: Escalate to the bank's Principal Nodal Officer (PNO); issue a summons under BNSS Section 94 for personal appearance of the Branch Manager.

steps.title: Telecom Subscriber Analysis & CDR/Tower Dump Requisition
steps.description: Analyse the mobile numbers linked to the suspect VPA and bank KYC. Issue notices to the respective Telecom Service Providers for Customer Application Forms (CAF), Call Detail Records (CDR) with Cell ID timestamps, and IMEI histories to trace the physical location of the fraudster or mule handler.
required_evidence: Subscriber CAF with ID proof and photograph
CDR for the relevant period with Cell ID tower locations
IMEI search history / handset tracking logs
steps.condition_to_start: Mobile numbers identified from UPI VPA mapping or bank account KYC.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of CAF, CDR, and IMEI logs from the TSP with Section 63 BSA electronic certificate.
if_blocked: Escalate to the Chief Nodal Officer of the telecom operator or route prioritization through SP/DCP Cyber Crime.

steps.title: ISP Resolution of Banking Login IP Addresses
steps.description: Analyse the public IP addresses and timestamps obtained from the bank's login logs or NPCI transaction initiation logs. Send requisition notices to the relevant Internet Service Provider to obtain IPDR and NAT port binding logs to identify the real physical installation address and subscriber.
required_evidence: IPDR / NAT port binding logs with exact UTC/IST timestamps
ISP subscriber KYC (billing name, installation address, MAC address binding)
steps.condition_to_start: Public IP address, exact timestamp (down to seconds), and NAT source port identified from bank/NPCI server logs.
steps.condition_to_complete: ISP provides positive identification of the subscriber and physical premises address.
if_blocked: If CGNAT port was not logged by the bank, request mobile data session logs (GPRS/4G IPDR) directly from the telecom operator under entity_id telecom_operator.

steps.title: ATM / Branch CCTV Footage Procurement
steps.description: If the defrauded funds were withdrawn via ATM cash withdrawals or branch cheques, immediately issue a notice to the acquiring bank for CCTV footage of the ATM kiosk or branch counter corresponding to the exact transaction timestamps.
required_evidence: Video footage of the ATM kiosk or branch counter covering the withdrawal window
ATM Electronic Journal (EJ) transaction logs
steps.condition_to_start: Bank statement confirms cash withdrawal via ATM or physical branch encashment.
steps.condition_to_complete: Procurement of clear CCTV video clips and EJ logs showing the physical withdrawal.
if_blocked: If footage is stored on a local branch DVR about to be overwritten, execute an immediate physical inspection and seizure under BNSS Section 106.

steps.title: Search, Seizure, and Arrest of Accused / Mule Handlers
steps.description: Conduct a coordinated raid at the physical locations identified via CDR cell towers, ISP installation addresses, and ATM CCTV identification. Arrest the accused, seize mobile handsets, SIM cards, ATM cards, and passbooks, and ensure forensic imaging of digital devices.
required_evidence: Seizure memo / Panchnama of mobile phones, SIM cards, debit cards, and computing devices
Arrest memo and medical examination report
Hash values / forensic mirror images of seized digital media
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable physical location and identity established through CDR, IPDR, or CCTV evidence.
steps.condition_to_complete: Successful execution of search warrant, seizure of digital exhibits, and forwarding of exhibits to FSL.
if_blocked: If the accused has fled to another state, coordinate with the State Cyber Cell / CID for interstate transit remand and operational support.

steps.title: Judicial Application for Release of Frozen Funds
steps.description: File a formal memorandum and supporting evidence before the jurisdictional Magistrate to assist the victim in obtaining a judicial order for the release and restoration of the frozen funds back to the complainant's bank account.
required_evidence: Certified copy of NCRP fund freeze confirmation / Bank lien order
Indemnity bond from the complainant
Investigating Officer's report endorsing fund restoration
steps.condition_to_start: Defrauded funds are confirmed frozen in the suspect bank account or wallet.
steps.condition_to_complete: Magistrate passes an order directing the bank to transfer the frozen funds to the victim's account.
if_blocked: If multiple victims are claiming the same frozen pool, file a consolidated distribution plan before the Chief Judicial Magistrate.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Funds were withdrawn via ATM by masked individuals with no clear facial recognition and SIM cards/bank accounts were procured using forged identity documents (mule accounts).
suggested_actions: Perform IMEI clustering on the handset used to access the UPI app to identify other SIM cards used in the same physical device.
Check the biometric authentication history of the account opening KYC via the bank or Business Correspondent (BC) point to identify the actual individual who provided fingerprints.
Request NPCI to globally blacklist the IMEI and linked mobile numbers across all UPI PSP ecosystems.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigating Card Skimming, Cloning & CNP Frauds
source: Synthesized from general police cyber investigation manuals and RBI guidelines on card security

steps.title: Victim Triage & Card Transaction History Profiling
steps.description: Interview the victim to establish whether the fraud was Card-Present (skimming/cloning at ATM/PoS) or Card-Not-Present (international e-commerce/phishing). Obtain the card statement, identify the exact compromised merchant/ATM locations, and confirm immediate card blocking.
required_evidence: Victim's written statement detailing recent physical card usage
Bank/Credit Card account statement showing unauthorized charges
Card blocking SMS/confirmation email from the issuer bank
steps.condition_to_start: Complainant reports unauthorized credit or debit card transactions.
steps.condition_to_complete: Categorization of fraud as physical skimming vs. online CNP, and identification of Point of Compromise (PoC).
if_blocked: If the issuer bank delays providing the transaction ledger, instruct the victim to download the unbilled transaction logs via official mobile banking apps.

steps.title: Point of Sale (PoS) / ATM Terminal Data Requisition
steps.description: Issue notices to the merchant bank (acquirer) and ATM operator where the card was last physically used (suspected skimming site) and where the fraudulent withdrawals/swipes occurred. Request Electronic Journal (EJ) logs, terminal IDs, and CCTV footage.
required_evidence: ATM Electronic Journal (EJ) / PoS transaction logs
Terminal ID and merchant establishment details
CCTV footage of the suspected skimming installation window and fraudulent withdrawal window
steps.condition_to_start: Identification of physical ATM kiosks or merchant PoS terminals used before and during the fraud.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of EJ logs and clear CCTV footage from the acquiring bank/ATM operator.
if_blocked: If the ATM is operated by a White Label ATM (WLA) entity, serve notice directly to the WLA nodal officer via RBI regional portal.

steps.title: E-Commerce & Payment Gateway Traceability (For CNP Fraud)
steps.description: If transactions were online (CNP), issue notices to the e-commerce merchants or payment aggregators (e.g., Razorpay, PayU, Amazon) identified in the card descriptor. Demand order details, delivery addresses, buyer KYC, and IP access logs.
required_evidence: Order invoice, item description, and shipping/delivery address
Buyer account KYC (email, mobile number, billing details)
Payment gateway logs showing IP address, device fingerprint, and OTP verification status
steps.condition_to_start: Card statement shows unauthorized online purchases or digital wallet top-ups.
steps.condition_to_complete: E-commerce platform provides complete order logs, delivery address, and buyer login IP.
if_blocked: If the transaction was an international CNP charge without 2FA, notify the card network (Visa/Mastercard) through the issuer bank for chargeback and fraud tagging.

steps.title: Courier & Logistics Delivery Interception / Tracing
steps.description: If physical goods were ordered using the stolen card data, issue notices to the courier company handling the shipment. Obtain Proof of Delivery (PoD), delivery agent contact details, and recipient phone numbers, or instruct an active intercept if the parcel is in transit.
required_evidence: Courier consignment tracking sheet and delivery run-sheet
Proof of Delivery (PoD) signature / OTP verification logs
Delivery executive's statement and GPS drop-off coordinates
steps.condition_to_start: E-commerce records confirm physical merchandise was shipped to a specific address.
steps.condition_to_complete: Identification of the physical recipient or successful interception of the parcel.
if_blocked: If the delivery address is a fake or open landmark (e.g., 'near bus stand'), subpoena the delivery executive's call logs to identify the phone number used to call the receiver.

steps.title: ISP / Telecom Tracing of Online Transactions
steps.description: Analyse the login and checkout IP addresses provided by the e-commerce platform or payment gateway. Issue notices to the ISP or TSP to resolve the public IP and NAT source port to a specific subscriber premises or mobile device.
required_evidence: IPDR logs resolving public IP and NAT port to private subscriber IP
Subscriber KYC and physical installation address
steps.condition_to_start: Valid IP address and timestamp obtained from e-commerce or gateway checkout logs.
steps.condition_to_complete: Positive identification of the ISP subscriber name and physical location.
if_blocked: If the IP resolves to a commercial VPN or proxy service, issue a preservation request to the VPN provider while focusing investigation on physical delivery trails.

steps.title: Physical Raid, Seizure of Skimming Hardware & Arrest
steps.description: Conduct a raid at the identified physical address (from delivery tracking, IPDR, or ATM CCTV surveillance). Seize skimming hardware (MSR writers, deep-insert skimmers, micro-cameras), cloned plastic cards, laptops, and arrest the suspects.
required_evidence: Seizure memo of magnetic stripe readers/writers, blank plastic cards, and skimmer bezels
Forensic mirror image of laptops and storage media containing compromised card dumps
Arrest memo and disclosure statements
steps.condition_to_start: Suspect identity and physical location established via CCTV, courier tracking, or IPDR.
steps.condition_to_complete: Seizure of card cloning paraphernalia and submission of hardware to FSL for technical examination.
if_blocked: If suspects are operating across district/state borders, request assistance from the State Cyber Cell / CID for specialized surveillance.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Card data was stolen via an international data breach or darkweb dump, and fraudulent transactions were executed on overseas payment gateways utilizing cryptocurrency or digital gift cards.
suggested_actions: Obtain the merchant descriptors and transaction BINs from the issuer bank and report the compromised card batch to CERT-In for systemic mitigation.
Analyse email addresses or phone numbers associated with the gift card redemptions by serving process on the respective online platforms via I4C international coordination.
Instruct the complainant to file a formal dispute with the card issuing bank under RBI Zero Liability Circular (DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18) for unauthorized CNP transactions without OTP.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigating Net Banking Phishing & Malware Account Takeovers
source: Synthesized from I4C Cyber Crime Investigation Guidelines and general LEA net banking SOPs

steps.title: Victim Session Profiling & Credential Compromise Assessment
steps.description: Examine the victim's device and communication history to determine the vector of compromise (phishing SMS/email, remote access RAT app like AnyDesk/TeamViewer, or malware APK). Secure screenshots of phishing links and SMS headers.
required_evidence: Screenshots of phishing SMS/WhatsApp messages with Sender ID and URL link [1.1.2]
Victim's bank statement showing unauthorized net banking transfers
List of recently installed applications or remote desktop tools on victim's phone/PC
steps.condition_to_start: Complainant reports unauthorized net banking login and fund transfer.
steps.condition_to_complete: Identification of the specific phishing domain, malicious APK, or remote access vector used to compromise credentials.
if_blocked: If the victim deleted the phishing SMS, instruct them to request SMS delivery logs from their telecom operator or examine the browser history.

steps.title: Phishing URL / Malicious Domain Takedown & Analysis
steps.description: Send formal requests to I4C and CERT-In to block the fraudulent phishing website URL or domain. Conduct WHOIS, DNS resolution, and hosting server IP analysis to identify the infrastructure provider housing the phishing site.
required_evidence: WHOIS registration details and domain registrar KYC
Hosting server IP address and DNS routing records
Acknowledgement from I4C/CERT-In regarding URL blocking
steps.condition_to_start: Active phishing URL or fraudulent banking web link identified from victim's device.
steps.condition_to_complete: Phishing domain is blocked nationally and hosting server IP details are procured.
if_blocked: If the domain is hosted on an offshore bulletproof host, report the phishing URLs directly to major browser phishing registries (Google Safe Browsing, Microsoft SmartScreen).

steps.title: Bank Server Login IP & Beneficiary Tracking Requisition
steps.description: Issue notices under BNSS Section 94 to the victim's bank to obtain internet banking access logs showing the IP addresses, timestamps, device fingerprints, and user-agents used for the unauthorized login and payee addition. Request immediate freezing of transferred funds at beneficiary banks.
required_evidence: Internet Banking login and transaction IP address logs with exact UTC/IST timestamps and port numbers
Beneficiary account numbers, IFSCs, and amount distribution tree
Confirmation of debit freeze / lien marking on beneficiary accounts under BNSS Section 106
steps.condition_to_start: Unauthorized net banking transaction confirmed.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of detailed login IP logs and confirmation of fund freezing in destination bank accounts.
if_blocked: If the bank provides only public IPs without source ports, immediately re-issue notice demanding NAT source ports and session IDs.

steps.title: Mule Account Investigation & ATM Withdrawal Tracing
steps.description: Investigate the first and second-layer beneficiary (mule) bank accounts where the stolen funds were transferred. Obtain full KYC, account opening photographs, mobile numbers, and ATM CCTV footage if funds were encashed.
required_evidence: Certified KYC dossiers of all recipient mule accounts
Bank statements showing subsequent fund dispersion or ATM encashment
ATM CCTV footage showing the physical withdrawer
steps.condition_to_start: Beneficiary bank account numbers identified from victim bank's transfer logs.
steps.condition_to_complete: Complete identification of mule account holders and extraction of withdrawal CCTV footage.
if_blocked: If funds were moved from bank accounts into crypto wallets, immediately transition tracking to entity_id vasp_crypto_exchange.

steps.title: ISP IPDR Tracing of Phishing Operators & Unauthorized Logins
steps.description: Issue notices to the respective ISPs or TSPs owning the public IP addresses logged during the phishing domain administration and the unauthorized net banking logins. Request IPDR and NAT port binding records.
required_evidence: IPDR logs mapping public IP and port to private subscriber IP
ISP subscriber KYC and physical installation address of the attacker
steps.condition_to_start: Attacker IP addresses obtained from bank server login logs or domain hosting logs.
steps.condition_to_complete: ISP confirms the physical location and identity of the internet subscriber.
if_blocked: If IP addresses resolve to mobile data networks (Jio/Airtel), route IPDR requisition through entity_id telecom_operator.

steps.title: Raid, Forensic Device Seizure & Arrest of Phishing Syndicate
steps.description: Execute search warrants at the physical locations identified via IPDR, telecom cell towers, and mule KYC. Arrest the phishing operators, SIM box operators, and mule handlers. Seize computers, mobile phones, and SIM cards.
required_evidence: Seizure memo / Panchnama of computing devices, SIM cards, and financial instruments
Forensic mirror images of hard drives and mobile handsets showing phishing scripts or banking credentials
Arrest memos and interrogation disclosures
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable physical location established from IPDR, telecom CDR, or ATM surveillance.
steps.condition_to_complete: Arrest of syndicate members, seizure of hardware, and submission of digital exhibits to FSL.
if_blocked: If the primary phishing syndicate operates from a known cybercrime hotspot outside the state (e.g., Jamtara, Mewat), coordinate raid execution with State Cyber Cell / CID.

steps.title: Judicial Application for Restitution of Defrauded Funds
steps.description: Submit a formal judicial report and application under BNSS Section 503 before the jurisdictional Magistrate to release any frozen funds held in beneficiary bank accounts back to the victim.
required_evidence: Bank confirmation letters of frozen balances under Section 106 BNSS
Victim's indemnity bond and application for release of property
Investigating Officer's formal no-objection / endorsement report
steps.condition_to_start: Defrauded funds are successfully secured/frozen in destination bank accounts.
steps.condition_to_complete: Court order directing the banks to release the frozen money to the complainant.
if_blocked: If the bank demands an indemnity bond before complying with the court order, facilitate the drafting and notarization of the bond for the victim.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Attacker utilized anonymizing Tor networks or multi-hop foreign VPNs for net banking login, and stolen funds were immediately dispersed across dozens of temporary digital wallets.
suggested_actions: Shift investigative focus from digital IP tracing to financial follow-the-money tracing by requesting NPCI and wallet aggregators for end-destination bank accounts.
Analyse the Call Detail Records (CDR) of the victim's phone around the time of compromise to identify incoming phishing/vishing phone numbers.
Check if the victim's mobile number experienced an unauthorized SIM swap or eSIM upgrade by serving notice on the telecom operator.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigating Fake Trading Apps & Stock/Forex Investment Scams
source: Synthesized from general practice, MHA cyber fraud guidelines, and SEBI/RBI advisories on illegal trading platforms

steps.title: Scam Platform Profiling & Evidence Preservation
steps.description: Collect complete details of the fraudulent investment scheme: social media advertisements, WhatsApp/Telegram group links, APK files, website URLs, and screenshots of fake trading dashboards showing inflated profits.
required_evidence: Screenshots of WhatsApp/Telegram group chats, admin numbers, and trade recommendations
APK file or website URL of the fake trading platform
Complainant's bank statements showing all outbound transfers to scam accounts
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports financial loss to an unregulated or fake stock/forex/crypto trading application.
steps.condition_to_complete: Compilation of all communication links, APK samples, and a verified schedule of defrauded financial transactions.
if_blocked: If the fraudulent application has been deleted or taken offline, extract the cached APK or web artifacts from the victim's smartphone using forensic extraction tools.

steps.title: Social Media & Messaging Platform Tracing
steps.description: Issue notices under BNSS Section 94 to Meta (WhatsApp/Facebook/Instagram) and Telegram (via official LEA channels) to obtain group admin KYC, subscriber IP logs, and linked phone numbers for the accounts that lured the victim.
required_evidence: Subscriber registration details, verified phone numbers, and email IDs of group admins
IP address logs with timestamps for group creation and message posting [1.1.1]
Account preservation confirmation from social media platforms
steps.condition_to_start: Social media profiles, WhatsApp group links, or Telegram channels identified from victim's phone.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of basic subscriber info and IP access logs from the messaging/social media platforms.
if_blocked: If Telegram or offshore platforms delay response, extract the admin phone numbers and invite links directly from the victim's chat history and run OSINT / telecom queries.

steps.title: Layered Financial Tracing & Freezing of Shell Company Accounts
steps.description: Analyse the beneficiary bank accounts (often registered under fake current accounts or shell companies). Issue immediate Section 106 BNSS notices to freeze funds across Level-1, Level-2, and Level-3 recipient accounts, and obtain complete bank KYC and transaction statements.
required_evidence: Certified bank statements and KYC dossiers of Level-1, Level-2, and Level-3 accounts [1.1.1]
Bank confirmations of debit freeze / lien placement under BNSS Section 106
Cheque leaf copies, NEFT/RTGS vouchers, and IP login logs of the shell accounts
steps.condition_to_start: Schedule of victim's outbound bank transfers established.
steps.condition_to_complete: Mapping of the multi-layered financial dispersion tree and freezing of available balances.
if_blocked: If funds are moving rapidly across dozens of banks, coordinate with the state I4C / CFCFRMS desk for automated multi-bank debit freezing.

steps.title: Corporate & Shell Company Verification (MCA21)
steps.description: If beneficiary bank accounts belong to Private Limited Companies, LLPs, or firms, access the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA21) database. Download incorporation documents, MOA/AOA, verify Director Identification Numbers (DIN), and trace registered office addresses.
required_evidence: Certificate of Incorporation, MOA, and AOA of suspect companies
DIN master details, KYC, and personal addresses of directors/signatories
Form INC-22 (registered office address) and bank account resolution documents
steps.condition_to_start: Beneficiary bank account KYC reveals a corporate entity or LLP name.
steps.condition_to_complete: Identification of real or dummy directors and physical verification status of the corporate registered address.
if_blocked: If the company is a shell entity with dummy directors (e.g., daily wage laborers), subpoena the bank's account introduction records to identify the professional intermediary (CA/CS) who opened the account.

steps.title: Telecom & ISP Tracing of Operators and Handlers
steps.description: Issue notices to TSPs and ISPs to trace the mobile numbers used by group admins, calling agents, and bank account operators. Obtain CAF, CDR with tower locations, and IPDR logs for bank account internet banking logins.
required_evidence: CAF and CDR with Cell ID locations for scam operator phone numbers
IPDR / NAT port logs for internet banking logins of shell accounts
IMEI tracking logs showing device clustering
steps.condition_to_start: Phone numbers and login IP addresses identified from social media logs and bank KYC.
steps.condition_to_complete: Positive identification of the operational physical locations and handsets of the syndicate members.
if_blocked: If telecom numbers are registered on fake IDs across multiple states, request analysis of frequent calling contacts (family/associates) from the CDR to establish true identity.

steps.title: Tracing Conversion of Funds to Cryptocurrency (VASPs)
steps.description: In investment scams, fiat funds in shell bank accounts are frequently transferred to crypto exchanges (e.g., CoinDCX, WazirX, Binance) to buy USDT. Issue notices under BNSS Section 94/106 to VASPs to freeze crypto wallets, obtain user KYC, and retrieve blockchain transaction ledgers.
required_evidence: VASP user KYC (PAN, Aadhaar, bank accounts linked, selfie verification)
Complete fiat deposit and crypto withdrawal ledgers with Transaction Hashes (TxIDs)
Confirmation of crypto wallet freezing under BNSS Section 106
Destination wallet addresses and external exchange clustering data
steps.condition_to_start: Bank statements of shell accounts show outbound transfers to known crypto exchange nodal accounts or P2P traders.
steps.condition_to_complete: Identification of crypto buyer KYC, freezing of available crypto assets, and mapping of outbound TxIDs.
if_blocked: If funds were moved via unregulated P2P crypto traders, issue Section 106 freeze notices to the P2P traders' Indian bank accounts to force their cooperation.

steps.title: Raid, Takedown of Call Centers & Arrest of Syndicate
steps.description: Conduct coordinated physical raids on identified call centers, shell company offices, or operational hubs. Arrest syndicate managers, tech developers, and finance handlers. Seize server hardware, mobile phones, forged rubber stamps, and cheque books.
required_evidence: Seizure memos of laptops, mobile phones, SIM boxes, company stamps, and banking kits
Forensic imaging of server storage and computers hosting fake trading dashboards
Arrest memos and voluntary disclosure statements
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable physical intelligence established from telecom CDR, ISP logs, MCA addresses, or VASP KYC.
steps.condition_to_complete: Arrest of key syndicate operatives, seizure of infrastructure, and submission of digital evidence to FSL.
if_blocked: If the core masterminds are operating from overseas jurisdictions (e.g., Southeast Asia), coordinate with State Cyber CID and CBI/Interpol for Look Out Circulars (LOCs) and MLAT requests.

steps.title: Judicial Restoration of Frozen Bank and Crypto Assets
steps.description: File a comprehensive investigation report and application under BNSS Section 503 / Section 107 before the jurisdictional court to attach proceeds of crime and restore frozen fiat balances and liquidated crypto assets to the victims.
required_evidence: Schedule of frozen bank balances and seized crypto assets
Victims' verification reports and indemnity bonds
Court order directing restitution of proceeds of crime
steps.condition_to_start: Investigating team has successfully frozen fiat funds in bank accounts or crypto assets at VASPs.
steps.condition_to_complete: Magistrate issues a formal restitution order transferring recovered funds to the complainants.
if_blocked: If multiple victims across India are claiming the same frozen accounts, request the court to establish an equitable pro-rata distribution formula.

dead_end_strategies.condition: The trading platform was hosted on offshore cloud servers with privacy-guard domain registration, and all stolen funds were converted to privacy coins or run through blockchain mixers (e.g., Tornado Cash) by overseas syndicates.
suggested_actions: Focus enforcement on the domestic Indian infrastructure: identify and arrest the local 'account aggregators' and CA/CS professionals who incorporated the Indian shell companies and provided bank accounts.
Request CERT-In and DoT to systematically block all associated web domains, IP addresses, and Telegram channels across Indian networks to prevent further victimization.
Submit the blockchain wallet clusters and scam IOCs to I4C and international blockchain intelligence databases (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM Labs) for global exchange blacklisting.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigating Cryptocurrency Thefts, Bogus ICOs & Wallet Hacks
source: Synthesized from general cyber forensic practices, MHA crypto investigation guidelines, and FIU-IND VASP frameworks

steps.title: Victim Wallet Profiling & Blockchain Transaction Triage
steps.description: Interview the victim to record exact details of the crypto loss: victim's public wallet address, destination/attacker wallet address, blockchain network (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tron, etc.), exact UTC/IST timestamps, and Transaction Hashes (TxIDs).
required_evidence: Victim's written statement and signed screenshot of wallet transaction history
Exact alphanumeric Transaction Hashes (TxIDs) / Block explorer URLs
Complainant's bank statement (if fiat money was used to purchase crypto initially)
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports theft of cryptocurrency or fraudulent transfer to a bogus crypto investment/ICO scheme.
steps.condition_to_complete: Verification of TxIDs on public block explorers and establishment of the initial on-chain movement of stolen assets.
if_blocked: If the victim does not understand blockchain transaction hashes, assist them in opening their wallet app (e.g., MetaMask, Trust Wallet, exchange app) and exporting the transaction log.

steps.title: On-Chain Forensic Tracing & Clustering
steps.description: Utilize specialized blockchain forensic analytical tools (or coordinate with State Cyber Cell / I4C) to trace the flow of stolen tokens across blockchain hops. Identify if funds move into centralized exchanges (CEXs), decentralized exchanges (DEXs), bridges, or mixing services.
required_evidence: Blockchain forensic flow diagram / tracing report showing wallet hops
Identification of destination deposit wallets belonging to Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs)
Cluster analysis linking suspect addresses to known entity tags or fraud campaigns
steps.condition_to_start: Verified initial TxIDs and attacker wallet addresses documented.
steps.condition_to_complete: Tracing report successfully identifies destination deposit addresses hosted at centralized crypto exchanges or fiat off-ramps.
if_blocked: If local police station lacks blockchain tracing software, immediately escalate the TxID list to the State Cyber Cell / CID or I4C technical desk for forensic graph generation.

steps.title: VASP Emergency Freeze & KYC Requisition
steps.description: Issue urgent notices under BNSS Section 94 and Section 106 to the domestic or FIU-registered offshore crypto exchanges (e.g., Binance, CoinDCX, WazirX) where stolen funds were deposited. Demand immediate wallet freeze, user KYC dossiers, login IP logs, and withdrawal histories.
required_evidence: Confirmation of emergency wallet/account freeze under BNSS Section 106
VASP customer KYC records (PAN, Aadhaar, bank account mapping, government ID, selfie photo)
Account login IP addresses, timestamps, device fingerprints, and API key logs
Fiat withdrawal history showing bank accounts where crypto was liquidated into INR
steps.condition_to_start: Blockchain tracing confirms stolen crypto tokens landed in a specific exchange deposit address.
steps.condition_to_complete: Exchange freezes the remaining balance and provides full KYC and IP logs of the account holder.
if_blocked: If the exchange is an non-compliant offshore entity without Indian LEA portals, route an emergency freeze request through INTERPOL / I4C international channels or issue public warning flags.

steps.title: Bank Fiat Off-Ramp Investigation & Freezing
steps.description: If the VASP records reveal that the suspect sold the stolen cryptocurrency for fiat currency (INR) via P2P trading or direct exchange withdrawals, immediately issue notices to the recipient bank accounts under BNSS Section 94/106 to freeze balances and procure bank KYC.
required_evidence: Certified bank statements of the fiat off-ramp accounts
Bank KYC dossiers of P2P traders or cash-out account holders
Confirmation of debit freeze / lien marking under BNSS Section 106
steps.condition_to_start: VASP withdrawal ledgers identify specific Indian bank account numbers used to cash out crypto into fiat INR.
steps.condition_to_complete: Freezing of fiat balances in destination bank accounts and complete identification of account holders.
if_blocked: If P2P traders claim they were innocent third parties who bought crypto unknowingly, summon them with their complete chat logs and bank ledgers to verify trade authenticity.

steps.title: Telecom & ISP Tracing of Wallet Operators
steps.description: Analyse the login IP addresses provided by the crypto exchange or the mobile numbers linked to the VASP KYC and P2P bank accounts. Issue notices to TSPs and ISPs for CAF, CDR with tower locations, and IPDR port resolution.
required_evidence: CAF and CDR with Cell ID locations for suspect mobile numbers
IPDR logs resolving exchange login public IPs to specific subscriber installation addresses
IMEI tracking history of devices used for exchange app access
steps.condition_to_start: Mobile numbers or login IP addresses identified from VASP KYC and bank records.
steps.condition_to_complete: Positive physical location and subscriber identification of the individual operating the crypto accounts.
if_blocked: If IP addresses resolve to non-telecom ISPs, serve notices directly under entity_id isp_non_telecom.

steps.title: Raid, Hardware Wallet Seizure & Private Key Extraction
steps.description: Conduct search and seizure operations at the physical premises identified via telecom, ISP, and bank KYC tracing. Secure hardware wallets (Ledger, Trezor), laptops, mobile phones, and physical seed phrase backups (paper/metal plates). Ensure strict digital forensic protocols.
required_evidence: Seizure memo of hardware wallets, computers, mobile phones, and written seed phrase notes
Forensic bit-stream images of seized storage media and live memory capture (if devices found unlocked)
Arrest memos and interrogation statements detailing wallet passwords and pins
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable physical address and suspect identity established from VASP, bank, and telecom tracing.
steps.condition_to_complete: Arrest of suspects, physical seizure of crypto storage hardware, and safe transfer of digital evidence to FSL.
if_blocked: If encrypted hardware wallets or devices are seized without PINs, submit them immediately to FSL / State Cyber CID for advanced cryptographic brute-force or side-channel extraction.

steps.title: Judicial Transfer and Restitution of Seized Crypto Assets
steps.description: Move an application before the jurisdictional Magistrate under BNSS Section 503 / Section 107 to transfer recovered cryptocurrency from suspect wallets/exchanges into an official LEA cold wallet or treasury account, and obtain orders for restitution to the victim.
required_evidence: VASP confirmation of frozen tokens or inventory of seized hardware wallets
Investigating Officer's report detailing the valuation and blockchain chain of custody
Judicial order authorizing transfer to LEA custody wallet or liquidation and refund to victim
steps.condition_to_start: Crypto tokens are frozen at an exchange or accessible via seized private keys/seed phrases.
steps.condition_to_complete: Legal transfer of recovered crypto assets to law enforcement control and subsequent court-ordered release to the complainant.
if_blocked: If the court is unfamiliar with crypto asset custody, submit an expert memorandum from FSL/I4C explaining the procedure for establishing a secure government hardware wallet.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Stolen cryptocurrency was passed through decentralized cross-chain bridges (e.g., Thorchain) or privacy mixers (e.g., Tornado Cash) and dispersed into unhosted non-custodial wallets with no known exchange deposit leads.
suggested_actions: Maintain continuous automated monitoring on the destination unhosted wallet addresses using blockchain tracking tools; set alert triggers for whenever funds eventually move to a centralized exchange (VASP) off-ramp.

Analyse the initial gas fee funding sources of the attacker's wallet (e.g., tracing where the ETH/BNB used to pay transaction fees originally came from), which often uncovers an older KYC-verified exchange account.
Circulate the attacker wallet addresses and transaction hashes to international cybercrime liaison desks (I4C / INTERPOL) to check for overlaps with global ransomware or APT syndicates.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigating Illegal Instant Loan App Harassment & Extortion
source: Synthesized from I4C/MHA Loan App Investigation SOPs, RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, and state police manuals

steps.title: Victim Triage, Evidence Preservation & Emergency Stop
steps.description: Instruct the victim to immediately cease all payments. Preserve digital evidence: download the APK file, secure screenshots of threatening messages, WhatsApp chats, call logs, morphed photographs sent to contacts, and bank statements showing loan disbursal and extortion payments.
required_evidence: Screenshots of abusive WhatsApp/SMS messages, call logs, and morphed photographs [1.4.1]
APK file of the instant loan application or Google Play Store link
Bank statement showing initial credit from the app and subsequent extortion payments
Copy of NCRP / cybercrime.gov.in complaint acknowledgement
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports harassment, extortion, or distribution of morphed photos by an instant loan application.
steps.condition_to_complete: Comprehensive dossier of digital evidence compiled and victim instructed on securing social media/phone permissions.
if_blocked: If the app has already been uninstalled from the victim's phone, extract app installation metadata and APK files from system backups or download repositories.

steps.title: App Store Takedown & Server Infrastructure Analysis
steps.description: Submit urgent requests to Google (if listed on Play Store), CERT-In, and I4C to ban and remove the fraudulent loan application and block associated website domains/APKs. Conduct reverse engineering of the APK to identify command-and-control (C2) servers and data exfiltration IPs.
required_evidence: Developer account details, APK package name, and upload IP from app store
C2 server IP addresses, domain names, and cloud hosting details obtained from APK analysis
Confirmation of app takedown and URL blocking from I4C/MeitY/Google
steps.condition_to_start: APK file or app store link of the fraudulent loan application identified.
steps.condition_to_complete: App is removed from public repositories and backend server infrastructure details are identified.
if_blocked: If the app is distributed via third-party websites or Telegram APK sharing, issue Section 69A blocking requests to CERT-In for the specific download URLs.

steps.title: Telecom Tracing of Extortion Callers & WhatsApp Numbers
steps.description: Issue notices under BNSS Section 94 to TSPs and Meta (WhatsApp) to trace the mobile numbers and virtual numbers used to make abusive calls and send morphed images. Obtain CAF, CDR with tower locations, and WhatsApp registration IP/device logs.
required_evidence: CAF and CDR with Cell ID locations for extortion phone numbers
WhatsApp subscriber registration logs, IP addresses, and linked device IMEI [1.1.1]
IMEI clustering logs showing physical devices used by recovery agents
steps.condition_to_start: List of harassing phone numbers and WhatsApp sender IDs compiled from victim's phone.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of CAF, CDR, and IMEI tracking data revealing the physical locations of call center agents.
if_blocked: If callers utilize virtual cloud telephony numbers (SIP/VoIP), issue notices to the DoT-licensed Virtual Network Operators (VNOs) to obtain the underlying destination IP and subscriber KYC.

steps.title: Financial Tracing of Lender Banks, NBFCs & Payment Gateways
steps.description: Analyse the bank accounts and UPI VPAs used to disburse loans and receive extortion repayments. Issue notices to beneficiary banks, payment aggregators (e.g., Razorpay, Cashfree), and RBI (via Sachet portal check) to freeze accounts, obtain KYC, and identify partner NBFCs.
required_evidence: Certified bank statements and KYC of disbursement and collection accounts
Payment gateway merchant onboarding KYC, settlement bank accounts, and agreement copies
Confirmation of account freezing under BNSS Section 106
Identification of NBFC license details (if app claimed tie-up with a registered NBFC)
steps.condition_to_start: Bank statements and UPI transaction receipts of the victim analyzed.
steps.condition_to_complete: Complete mapping of the financial collection network, freezing of available balances, and identification of corporate entities/NBFCs.
if_blocked: If an RBI-registered NBFC allowed its name to be used by an illegal app without oversight, report the NBFC to RBI Department of Supervision for regulatory cancellation while prosecuting directors criminally.

steps.title: ISP Tracing of C2 Servers and Extortion Call Centers
steps.description: Issue notices to ISPs housing the C2 servers or providing internet connectivity to the IP addresses logged by WhatsApp, payment gateways, and app admin panels. Obtain IPDR and subscriber physical installation addresses.
required_evidence: IPDR logs resolving public server/login IPs to specific private installation addresses
ISP subscriber KYC showing physical premises of call centers or server administrators
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable IP addresses identified from APK reverse engineering, WhatsApp logs, or payment gateways.
steps.condition_to_complete: Positive identification of the physical premises hosting the extortion call center or server management team.
if_blocked: If cloud servers are hosted with foreign providers (e.g., AWS, Alibaba Cloud), issue preservation requests via I4C while focusing immediate tactical action on telecom and payment gateway leads.

steps.title: Coordinated Raid on Extortion Call Centers & Arrests
steps.description: Conduct physical search and seizure operations at the identified call centers, recovery agency offices, or residential hubs. Arrest telecallers, team leaders, agency owners, and technical administrators. Seize computers, mobile phones, SIM boxes, and server scripts.
required_evidence: Seizure memos of laptops, mobile handsets, SIM cards, telecalling scripts, and employee registers
Forensic imaging of computers showing victim databases, contact lists, and morphed photographs
Arrest memos, employee muster rolls, and interrogation disclosures
steps.condition_to_start: Physical location of call centers established via telecom CDR tower dumps, ISP installation addresses, or payment gateway KYC.
steps.condition_to_complete: Dismantling of the extortion call center, arrest of operatives, and submission of seized digital media to FSL.
if_blocked: If call centers are outsourced to third-party telemarketing agencies across different states, coordinate multi-state raids through State Cyber CID and I4C.

steps.title: Investigation of Shell Companies & Chinese/Foreign Masterminds
steps.description: Access MCA21 database to investigate the corporate entities operating the collection accounts and payment gateway merchant IDs. Examine MOA/AOA, trace Indian dummy directors, and check for foreign national directors (often Chinese/Southeast Asian nationals) or holding structures.
required_evidence: Incorporation documents, annual returns, and DIN details of suspect companies
Identification of dummy Indian directors and foreign beneficial owners
Bank account opening resolutions and chartered accountant / company secretary facilitation records
steps.condition_to_start: Corporate names identified from bank accounts, payment gateways, or call center raids.
steps.condition_to_complete: Complete corporate mapping linking Indian shell entities and dummy directors to foreign syndicates.
if_blocked: If foreign masterminds have fled India, coordinate with Bureau of Immigration under entity_id immigration_border to issue Look Out Circulars (LOCs) or check historical travel logs.

steps.title: Judicial Application for Restitution and Defamation Relief
steps.description: Submit a comprehensive chargesheet and application under BNSS Section 503 before the jurisdictional court to release frozen extortion funds back to victims, and obtain judicial orders certifying the loan demands as illegal/extortionate to protect victims from credit score (CIBIL) harassment.
required_evidence: Schedule of frozen bank balances and seized assets
Investigating Officer's report detailing the illegal nature of the unregulated lending app
Court order directing restitution of extorted money and quashing illegal loan liabilities
steps.condition_to_start: Extortion funds frozen in bank accounts and investigation establishes the unregulated/illegal nature of the app.
steps.condition_to_complete: Court issues restitution orders and formal findings of illegal extortion.
if_blocked: If credit bureaus (CIBIL/Experian) have marked victim defaults based on illegal NBFC reporting, forward the certified court order and FIR to RBI Department of Supervision to mandate credit score restoration.

dead_end_strategies.condition: The loan app is entirely unregulated, hosted on offshore servers, telecallers operate via VOIP from neighboring countries, and collection bank accounts are temporary UPI mule accounts drained daily.
suggested_actions: Execute an immediate technical containment strategy: submit the APK hash, C2 domains, and collection VPAs to I4C and MeitY for nationwide ISP blocking and NPCI VPA blacklisting [1.4.1].
Focus investigation on the domestic payment aggregators and fintech intermediaries that provided merchant onboarding to the unregulated app without physical office verification.

Provide the victim with an official police advisory/certificate stating the app is a cyber extortion fraud, enabling the victim to share it with their contacts to neutralize the defamation/harassment campaign.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigating Digital Arrest & Law Enforcement Impersonation Scams
source: Synthesized from MHA/I4C advisories on Digital Arrest, Supreme Court/CBI guidelines, and state cyber SOPs

steps.title: Victim Triage, Evidence Collection & Emergency 1930 Reporting
steps.description: Verify the complaint on NCRP / 1930 [1.3.1]. Interview the victim to record details of the fake 'Digital Arrest': automated IVR calls (claiming FedEx/DoT/Customs/TRAI), video call interrogation platforms (Skype/WhatsApp), fake arrest warrants/Supreme Court orders, and RTGS/NEFT transfer receipts to 'secret government verification accounts'.
required_evidence: Screenshots/recordings of video calls showing scammers in fake police/CBI uniforms or virtual courtrooms [1.3.2]
Copies of forged arrest warrants, CBI/ED notices, or RBI asset seizure orders
Complainant's bank statements and RTGS/NEFT/IMPS transaction reference numbers
NCRP / CFCFRMS Ticket Acknowledgement Number
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports extortion and fund transfer under threat of 'Digital Arrest' by impersonators of police/CBI/ED/Customs.
steps.condition_to_complete: Emergency debit freeze initiated via NCRP and complete dossier of forged documents and transaction reference numbers compiled.
if_blocked: If the victim is still under active psychological intimidation or video monitoring by scammers, immediately intervene, sever the video link, and provide physical police reassurance [1.3.2].

steps.title: Multi-Layered Bank Account Tracing & Freezing
steps.description: In Digital Arrest scams, large sums (lakhs to crores) are transferred via RTGS/NEFT into corporate or individual mule accounts. Issue immediate Section 106 BNSS notices to freeze funds across Level-1, Level-2, and Level-3 beneficiary banks, and obtain full KYC, account opening forms, and IP login logs.
required_evidence: Certified bank statements and KYC dossiers of all recipient accounts [1.3.2]
Bank confirmations of debit freeze / lien placement under BNSS Section 106
RTGS/NEFT routing vouchers and cheque encashment details
Internet banking login IP addresses and device fingerprints of the recipient accounts
steps.condition_to_start: Destination bank account numbers and IFSCs identified from victim's transfer receipts.
steps.condition_to_complete: Freezing of available funds across the banking chain and receipt of complete KYC/IP logs of account holders.
if_blocked: If funds were split into dozens of accounts across multiple states, coordinate with I4C / MHA CFCFRMS desk for emergency centralized freezing [1.3.1].

steps.title: Telecom & VOIP Tracing of Initial Callers & Video Interrogators
steps.description: Issue notices under BNSS Section 94 to TSPs and Meta (WhatsApp) / Microsoft (Skype) to trace the phone numbers, IVR lines, and video calling profiles used to contact the victim. Obtain CAF, CDR with tower locations, and IP access logs for the Skype/WhatsApp accounts.
required_evidence: CAF and CDR with Cell ID locations for phone numbers used in the initial scam call
Skype / WhatsApp subscriber KYC, profile IDs, and IP address login logs with timestamps [1.3.2]
IMEI tracking history and handset clustering data
steps.condition_to_start: Phone numbers, Skype IDs, or WhatsApp numbers identified from victim's call logs.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of CAF, CDR, and video platform IP logs revealing the physical infrastructure or SIP trunking providers used.
if_blocked: If initial calls originated from spoofed international numbers or illegal SIM boxes, coordinate with DoT TERM cell to trace the gateway switch [1.3.1].

steps.title: Corporate & Mule Account Verification (MCA21)
steps.description: If the 'secret government verification accounts' belong to Private Limited Companies or LLPs, query the MCA21 database. Download incorporation records, MOA/AOA, check DIN details, and verify the physical registered office addresses of these shell entities.
required_evidence: Certificate of Incorporation, MOA, and AOA of recipient shell companies
DIN master details, KYC, and physical addresses of directors
Bank account opening resolutions and introductory CA/CS documentation
steps.condition_to_start: Beneficiary bank account KYC reveals a corporate entity or firm name.
steps.condition_to_complete: Identification of company directors and verification of whether the business address is genuine or a fake shell address.
if_blocked: If directors are untraceable dummy individuals, subpoena the bank's KYC verification officer who conducted the physical pre-opening site visit.

steps.title: ISP Tracing of Video Call Studios and Account Handlers
steps.description: Analyse the IP addresses obtained from Skype/WhatsApp video interrogation logs and bank internet banking login logs. Issue notices to ISPs to obtain IPDR, NAT port binding records, and physical installation addresses.
required_evidence: IPDR logs resolving public video/login IPs and NAT ports to specific subscriber private IPs
ISP subscriber KYC showing physical premises of the fake video studio or money handler
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable IP addresses and timestamps obtained from video calling platforms or bank servers.
steps.condition_to_complete: Positive identification of the ISP subscriber name and physical address where the video call center or banking operations are located.
if_blocked: If video calls originated from foreign IP space (e.g., Southeast Asian scam compounds), route intelligence through I4C and CBI (as lead agency for Digital Arrest cases) [1.3.2].

steps.title: Coordinated Raid on Fake Police Studios & Syndicate Arrests
steps.description: Conduct search and seizure operations at the identified physical premises (from ISP logs, telecom CDR, or MCA addresses). Arrest impersonators, telecallers, and mule handlers. Seize fake police/CBI uniforms, studio backdrops, laptops, routers, mobile phones, and forged seals.
required_evidence: Seizure memos of fake uniforms, banners, government seals, computing devices, and SIM boxes [1.3.2]
Forensic imaging of computers and mobile phones showing green screens, video scripts, and victim dossiers
Arrest memos and interrogation statements detailing syndicate hierarchy
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable physical address established within Indian jurisdiction via ISP, telecom, or bank tracing.
steps.condition_to_complete: Dismantling of the fake interrogation studio, arrest of operatives, and submission of digital/physical exhibits to FSL.
if_blocked: If the raid involves interstate jurisdiction or transnational syndicates, coordinate with CBI / State Cyber CID under established national protocols [1.3.2].

steps.title: Judicial Application for Refund of Extorted Funds
steps.description: File a detailed report and application under BNSS Section 503 / Section 457 before the jurisdictional Magistrate to release the frozen money held in shell company or mule bank accounts back to the victim's account.
required_evidence: Certified schedule of frozen balances in beneficiary bank accounts [1.3.2]
Complainant's application under BNSS Section 503 / Section 457 supported by indemnity bond
Investigating Officer's official report confirming the money as proceeds of cyber extortion
steps.condition_to_start: Extorted funds are successfully frozen in recipient bank accounts.
steps.condition_to_complete: Magistrate passes a formal judicial order directing the banks to transfer the frozen funds back to the victim.
if_blocked: If bank accounts are contested by third-parties claiming legitimate trade, present the forensic chain of custody linking the deposit directly to the victim's RTGS transfer timestamp.

dead_end_strategies.condition: The video interrogation call center operates from an overseas scam compound (e.g., Cambodia, Myanmar, Laos), local bank accounts were drained via crypto ATMs within minutes, and callers used untraceable spoofed VoIP numbers.
suggested_actions: Transfer investigative focus to the domestic Indian money laundering and logistics network: identify, raid, and arrest the local 'mule account arrangators', SIM box operators, and crypto P2P cash-out agents.
Compile complete technical indicators (spoofed IPs, VoIP trunk providers, destination crypto wallets) and forward them to CBI (Nodal Agency for Digital Arrest) and I4C for Interpol/MLAT action.
Request DoT and telecom operators to block the international SIP trunking gateways and short-codes being utilized by the syndicate to spoof Indian government telephone numbers.

crime_type: Business Email Compromise / Vendor Payment Fraud
title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigating Business Email Compromise (BEC) & Invoice Manipulation Frauds
source: Synthesized from I4C Corporate Cyber Fraud guidelines, CERT-In advisories, and international LEA BEC SOPs

steps.title: Victim Triage & Email Header / Domain Spoofing Analysis
steps.description: Collect the complete raw email headers (.eml / .msg files) of the fraudulent emails requesting payment redirection or invoice modification. Analyse SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authentication results, routing hops, originating IP addresses, and lookalike domain variations (typosquatting).
required_evidence: Raw email files (.eml/.msg) with complete header metadata
Original genuine vendor invoice vs. manipulated fraudulent invoice showing altered bank account details
Complainant company's bank payment advice / SWIFT/RTGS transfer confirmation
steps.condition_to_start: Company reports unauthorized fund transfer due to email spoofing, executive impersonation (CEO fraud), or vendor invoice manipulation.
steps.condition_to_complete: Identification of the exact spoofing mechanism (lookalike domain vs. compromised email account) and originating sender IP address.
if_blocked: If internal IT staff cannot extract raw headers, deploy a cyber forensic specialist to export the email server logs or Office 365 / Google Workspace audit logs directly.

steps.title: Emergency Bank Freezing & SWIFT / RTGS Recall
steps.description: Immediately issue notices under BNSS Section 106 to the beneficiary bank where the funds were wired. If funds were transferred domestically via RTGS/NEFT, freeze the recipient account. If wired internationally via SWIFT, instruct the remitting bank to send an urgent SWIFT MT192 / recall indemnification message.
required_evidence: Certified bank ledger statement of the recipient account (for domestic transfers)
Bank confirmation of debit freeze under BNSS Section 106
Copy of SWIFT recall message (MT192) and foreign correspondent bank communication (for cross-border wires)
steps.condition_to_start: Beneficiary bank account number, IFSC, or SWIFT BIC identified from the fraudulent invoice or wire receipt.
steps.condition_to_complete: Confirmation of fund freezing in the domestic bank account or formal acknowledgment of SWIFT recall from the destination bank.
if_blocked: If the transfer is cross-border and the foreign bank is non-responsive, immediately engage I4C / CBI Interpol Nodal Desk to trigger international financial intelligence channel freezing.

steps.title: Email Service Provider (ESP) & Domain Registrar Requisition
steps.description: Issue notices under BNSS Section 94 to the domain registrar of the lookalike typosquatting domain, or to the Email Service Provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GoDaddy) if a corporate email account was compromised. Demand WHOIS KYC, account login IP logs, mailbox forwarding rules, and access timestamps.
required_evidence: WHOIS registration KYC and payment method used to purchase the lookalike domain
Email account login IP addresses, timestamps, and device user-agents
Audit logs showing unauthorized email forwarding rules or inbox manipulation
steps.condition_to_start: Lookalike domain name or compromised email infrastructure identified during header analysis.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of domain registrar KYC, login IP logs, and proof of unauthorized mailbox forwarding rules.
if_blocked: If the domain registrar is an offshore entity (e.g., Namecheap, Cloudflare), submit a formal abuse report and legal preservation request while pursuing domestic bank trails.

steps.title: Corporate & Beneficiary Account Investigation (MCA21)
steps.description: In domestic BEC cases, fraudulent invoices often direct funds to newly incorporated Indian companies with names similar to the genuine vendor. Query MCA21 to obtain incorporation documents, verify DIN details, and check physical registered office addresses.
required_evidence: Certificate of Incorporation, MOA, and AOA of the recipient corporate entity
DIN master details, KYC, and physical addresses of directors/signatories
Bank account opening resolutions and introductory CA/CS documentation
steps.condition_to_start: Domestic beneficiary bank account belongs to a corporate entity, LLP, or registered firm.
steps.condition_to_complete: Identification of company directors and determination of whether the entity is a genuine business or a purpose-built BEC shell company.
if_blocked: If the company is a shell entity with untraceable directors, subpoena the bank's account onboarding branch manager and introductory references under BNSS Section 94.

steps.title: ISP Tracing of Email Attackers and Bank Account Operators
steps.description: Analyse the IP addresses obtained from email server login logs, domain registration records, and recipient bank internet banking logs. Issue notices to ISPs to obtain IPDR, NAT port binding records, and subscriber installation addresses.
required_evidence: IPDR logs resolving public attacker/login IPs and NAT ports to private subscriber IPs
ISP subscriber KYC showing physical premises of the email attacker or finance handler
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable IP addresses and timestamps obtained from ESPs, registrars, or bank logs.
steps.condition_to_complete: ISP confirms the physical location and identity of the internet subscriber operating the compromised accounts.
if_blocked: If IP addresses resolve to mobile data networks, route IPDR and tower dump requisitions through entity_id telecom_operator.

steps.title: Raid, Forensic Server Seizure & Arrest of BEC Syndicate
steps.description: Execute search warrants at the physical locations identified via ISP, telecom, and MCA tracing. Arrest syndicate members, money mules, and corporate facilitators. Seize laptops, servers, mobile phones, forged invoices, and company rubber stamps.
required_evidence: Seizure memos of computing devices, mobile phones, company seals, and financial ledgers
Forensic mirror images of hard drives showing email spoofing software, compromised credentials, and altered invoices
Arrest memos and interrogation disclosures
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable physical address established from ISP, telecom, or MCA corporate records.
steps.condition_to_complete: Arrest of BEC operatives, physical seizure of hardware and documents, and submission of digital evidence to FSL.
if_blocked: If the core email intrusion occurred from overseas while domestic actors handled money laundering, coordinate with State Cyber CID / CBI for international MLAT processing.

steps.title: Judicial Application for Restitution of Corporate Funds
steps.description: Submit a formal investigation report and application under BNSS Section 503 before the jurisdictional Magistrate or High Court to release frozen funds held in recipient bank accounts back to the victimized company.
required_evidence: Certified schedule of frozen balances in recipient bank accounts
Company's board resolution, authorization letter, and indemnity bond for property release
Investigating Officer's official report endorsing the return of defrauded funds
steps.condition_to_start: Defrauded corporate funds are successfully frozen in domestic recipient bank accounts.
steps.condition_to_complete: Court order directing the banks to release and wire the frozen funds back to the complainant company's account.
if_blocked: If the recipient bank account is involved in insolvency or NCLT proceedings due to shell company fraud, file an urgent application before NCLT establishing that the funds are proceeds of crime under BNSS/PMLA.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Funds were wired internationally to an offshore jurisdiction (e.g., Hong Kong, UAE, Nigeria) via SWIFT, the destination account was cleared immediately upon landing, and email intrusion was executed via anonymized proxies.
suggested_actions: File an immediate international fraud report through CBI (Interpol National Central Bureau India) for issuance of a Purple/Blue Notice against the offshore bank account holders.
Conduct a thorough forensic audit of the complainant company's internal IT systems and employees to rule out an insider threat or negligent credential leakage that enabled the BEC.

Advise the complainant company to notify its cyber insurance carrier and implement mandatory out-of-band two-factor communication verification (e.g., verbal phone confirmation on pre-known numbers) for all future vendor bank account changes.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigating Cyber Insurance Fraud & Staged Policy Scams
source: Synthesized from IRDAI fraud guidelines, insurance company LEA manuals, and general police economic offense SOPs

steps.title: Insurance Policy & Claim Dossier Requisition
steps.description: Issue notices under BNSS Section 94 to the insurance company (Life, Health, or Motor) to obtain the complete policy inception file, proposal forms, KYC documents, medical declarations, nominee details, claim settlement records, and internal field surveyor investigation reports.
required_evidence: Certified copy of insurance policy, proposal form, and KYC submitted at inception
Nominee change history and premium payment ledger (bank routing details)
Claim settlement dossier, discharge vouchers, and payout bank account details
Internal insurance fraud investigation report and field surveyor findings
steps.condition_to_start: Complainant or insurance company reports fraudulent claim settlement, policy takeover, or staged accident/death claim.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of complete policy and claim dossier from the insurance company.
if_blocked: If the insurance branch delays providing internal surveyor reports, escalate to the Chief Grievance Officer or Zonal Manager of the insurance company.

steps.title: Freezing of Claim Payout Bank Accounts & KYC Retrieval
steps.description: Analyse the bank account where the insurance claim payout was disbursed or attempted to be disbursed. Issue immediate notices under BNSS Section 106/94 to the beneficiary bank to freeze remaining funds and procure complete account holder KYC and statement ledgers.
required_evidence: Certified bank statement of the claim payout recipient account
Account opening KYC, photograph, and linked mobile number of the recipient
Confirmation of debit freeze / lien marking under BNSS Section 106
steps.condition_to_start: Claim payout bank account number and IFSC identified from insurance settlement records.
steps.condition_to_complete: Freezing of claim funds in the recipient bank account and receipt of bank KYC dossier.
if_blocked: If the claim payout was withdrawn via cash or cheque immediately upon deposit, summon the branch manager and obtain counter CCTV footage of the encashment under BNSS Section 94.

steps.title: Tracing Online Policy Manipulation & Nominee Changes
steps.description: If the fraud involved online policy takeover or unauthorized change of nominee via customer portals/apps, issue notices to the insurance company's IT desk for web server login logs, IP addresses, OTP generation logs, and device identifiers.
required_evidence: Web portal / app login IP addresses with exact timestamps and port numbers
OTP dispatch logs showing which mobile number received the authorization OTP
Audit logs of nominee modification or bank account update requests
steps.condition_to_start: Insurance records indicate policy terms, nominee, or bank details were modified online prior to claim submission.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of server login IP logs and OTP dispatch records from the insurance company.
if_blocked: If policy changes were executed via aggregator apps (e.g., PolicyBazaar), serve Section 94 BNSS notice directly on the digital aggregator platform.

steps.title: Hospital & Medical Record Forensic Verification (For Life/Health Claims)
steps.description: In suspected fake death or fraudulent hospitalization claims, issue notices under BNSS Section 94 to the hospital or medical examiner that issued the MLC, admission summaries, or post-mortem reports. Verify whether the patient was genuinely admitted or if records were forged.
required_evidence: Certified copies of patient admission/discharge registers and treatment case sheets
Medico-Legal Case (MLC) or Post-Mortem autopsy report certification
Written statement of the treating doctor / Chief Medical Officer (CMO) confirming or denying record authenticity
steps.condition_to_start: Insurance claim relies on hospital treatment bills, MLCs, or death/autopsy certificates.
steps.condition_to_complete: Definitive verification from hospital authorities regarding whether medical records are genuine or fabricated.
if_blocked: If the hospital is an unregistered nursing home that has shut down, seize physical registers from municipal health department archives or verify doctor registration with the State Medical Council.

steps.title: Municipal Birth / Death Certificate Verification
steps.description: If a death certificate was submitted to claim life insurance, issue a requisition to the Municipal Corporation / Registrar of Births and Deaths to verify the authenticity of the death registration certificate and inspect backend declaration records.
required_evidence: Written verification report from Municipal Registrar confirming if Death Certificate is genuine or fake
Copy of original death declaration form, crematorium/burial receipt, and applicant KYC from municipal archives
steps.condition_to_start: Death certificate submitted as primary evidence for life insurance claim settlement.
steps.condition_to_complete: Official confirmation from municipal authorities regarding the validity of the death certificate.
if_blocked: If rural Panchayat records are disorganized, summon the Gram Panchayat Secretary with original registers to the police station for inspection.

steps.title: Telecom & ISP Tracing of Fraudulent Claimants and Agents
steps.description: Analyse mobile numbers linked to the insurance policy, bank KYC, and hospital admission forms, as well as IP addresses from portal logins. Issue notices to TSPs and ISPs for CAF, CDR with tower locations, and IPDR port resolution.
required_evidence: CAF and CDR with Cell ID locations for claimant and intermediary phone numbers
IPDR logs resolving insurance portal login public IPs to specific installation addresses
Call analysis showing communication frequency between policyholder, nominee, hospital staff, and insurance agents
steps.condition_to_start: Phone numbers and login IP addresses identified from insurance dossiers and bank KYC.
steps.condition_to_complete: Positive physical location and subscriber identification of the syndicate members.
if_blocked: If IP addresses resolve to non-telecom ISPs, route IPDR requisitions through entity_id isp_non_telecom.

steps.title: Raid, Seizure of Forged Medical/Municipal Documents & Arrest
steps.description: Conduct search and seizure operations at the premises of the fraudulent claimants, rogue insurance agents, or corrupt medical practitioners. Seize forged rubber stamps of hospitals/municipalities, fake death certificates, computers, and financial records. Arrest the conspirators.
required_evidence: Seizure memos of blank hospital letterheads, fake municipal seals, forged certificates, and computing devices
Forensic imaging of computers and mobile phones showing templates of fabricated medical/death records
Arrest memos and interrogation disclosures detailing the conspiracy
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable evidence of forgery and physical location established from hospital, municipal, telecom, or ISP verification.
steps.condition_to_complete: Arrest of syndicate operatives, physical seizure of forgery tools, and submission of documentary/digital exhibits to FSL.
if_blocked: If the 'deceased' policyholder is suspected to be alive and hiding, utilize CDR tower tracking and facial recognition across local CCTV/e-Challan databases under entity_id rto_parivahan to apprehend them.

steps.title: Judicial Cancellation of Fraudulent Claims and Fund Restitution
steps.description: Submit a comprehensive chargesheet and application under BNSS Section 503 before the jurisdictional court to return frozen claim payouts to the insurance company (or genuine rightful nominee), and obtain judicial cancellation of fabricated public certificates.
required_evidence: Schedule of frozen bank balances and seized property
Investigating Officer's report establishing the staged/fraudulent nature of the claim
Court order directing restitution of funds and directing municipal/hospital authorities to expunge fake records
steps.condition_to_start: Fraudulent claim funds frozen in bank accounts and forgery established via investigation.
steps.condition_to_complete: Court issues restitution orders and directs cancellation of forged statutory certificates.
if_blocked: If the fraud involved motor accident claims (MACT), file an urgent intervention application before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal to stay pending compensation awards based on police findings.

dead_end_strategies.condition: A terminally ill individual was insured using fake health declarations by an organized gang, who subsequently claimed insurance after natural death, leaving no obvious signs of document forgery.
suggested_actions: Subpoena the historical prescription logs, diagnostic lab reports, and pharmacy billing records of the deceased prior to policy inception using Section 94 BNSS notices on local healthcare providers.
Analyse the financial trail of who actually paid the initial policy premiums (often wired by the syndicate leader rather than the insured individual) via bank ledger scrutiny.
Examine the Call Detail Records (CDR) of the insurance sales agent and medical examiner who approved the proposal form to establish unlawful collusion with the claimant gang.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigating E-commerce Purchase, Fake Seller & Refund Frauds
source: Synthesized from Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020, I4C guidelines, and cyber police marketplace SOPs

steps.title: E-Commerce Platform Requisition (Order, KYC & Payment Logs)
steps.description: Issue notices under BNSS Section 94 to the e-commerce platform (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, OLX) via their designated 24x7 LEA Nodal Officer. Obtain buyer/seller KYC, order history, invoice copies, payment gateway reference IDs, IP login logs, and device identifiers.
required_evidence: Buyer and Seller KYC (mobile number, email, registered address, PAN, GSTIN, bank account mapping)
Order invoice, item description, transaction timestamps, and payment gateway logs
Account login and order placement IP addresses with timestamps and device IMEI/MAC logs
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports non-delivery of purchased goods, receipt of fake/counterfeit products, or platform reports systematic refund/return fraud.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receipt of complete transaction dossier, seller/buyer KYC, and IP logs within statutorily mandated 72 hours.
if_blocked: If the e-commerce entity delays response beyond 72 hours, issue a show-cause notice under Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020 and IT Act Section 79.

steps.title: Freezing of Seller Payouts / Refund Bank Accounts
steps.description: Analyse the bank account where seller disbursements or fraudulent refunds were routed. Issue immediate notices under BNSS Section 106/94 to the merchant bank or payment aggregator to freeze available balances and procure complete account KYC and ledgers.
required_evidence: Certified bank ledger statement of the seller payout or refund recipient account
Account opening KYC documents (Aadhaar, PAN, photograph, physical address)
Confirmation of debit freeze / lien marking under BNSS Section 106
steps.condition_to_start: Bank account number and IFSC identified from e-commerce seller payout logs or refund destination records.
steps.condition_to_complete: Freezing of funds in the target bank account and receipt of complete bank KYC dossier.
if_blocked: If the seller account is a nodal wallet or fintech aggregator account, serve notice directly on the underlying PSP under entity_id upi_npci.

steps.title: Courier & Logistics Verification (Delivery & Return Tracking)
steps.description: Issue notices to the courier/logistics partner (Blue Dart, Delhivery, India Post) handling the delivery or reverse-pickup return. Obtain delivery run-sheets, Proof of Delivery (PoD) OTP logs, GPS drop-off coordinates, weight/dimension scanning logs, and delivery agent statements.
required_evidence: Courier tracking run-sheet, delivery timestamp, and recipient OTP / signature log
Warehouse automated scanning logs showing package weight and X-ray dimensions at dispatch vs. return
Written statement of delivery / pickup executive and GPS location coordinates
steps.condition_to_start: Order tracking ID identified from e-commerce platform records.
steps.condition_to_complete: Reconstruction of physical package movement, verification of weight discrepancies (in return fraud), and identification of physical handler.
if_blocked: If delivery agents are suspected of colluding with refund fraudsters by logging fake returns, subpoena the agent's personal mobile CDR and bank statements.

steps.title: Telecom & ISP Tracing of Online Fraudsters and Sellers
steps.description: Analyse mobile numbers linked to buyer/seller accounts, delivery contact numbers, and IP addresses from platform login logs. Issue notices to TSPs and ISPs for CAF, CDR with tower locations, and IPDR port resolution.
required_evidence: CAF and CDR with Cell ID locations for seller, buyer, and intermediary phone numbers
IPDR logs resolving e-commerce login public IPs and NAT ports to private subscriber installation addresses
IMEI tracking logs showing device clustering across multiple fake buyer/seller accounts
steps.condition_to_start: Phone numbers and login IP addresses identified from e-commerce KYC and payment logs.
steps.condition_to_complete: Positive physical location and subscriber identification of the fraud syndicate.
if_blocked: If IP addresses resolve to non-telecom ISPs, route IPDR requisitions through entity_id isp_non_telecom.

steps.title: Raid, Seizure of Counterfeit Goods / Warehouses & Arrest
steps.description: Conduct search and seizure operations at the identified seller warehouses, residential premises of refund fraudsters, or illicit call centers. Seize counterfeit merchandise, stolen electronics, laptops, mobile phones, packaging machines, and SIM cards. Arrest the culprits.
required_evidence: Seizure memos of counterfeit inventory, returned merchandise, computers, mobile phones, and packaging material
Forensic mirror images of computers showing multi-account management scripts or fake invoice generators
Arrest memos and interrogation disclosures
steps.condition_to_start: Actionable physical premises established from logistics tracking, ISP installation addresses, or bank KYC.
steps.condition_to_complete: Arrest of operatives, physical seizure of goods/hardware, and submission of digital exhibits to FSL.
